vcpuFactory.description: Observer notes: system exposes unlimited vCPU factory 1-1024 with 12 curated presets nano to 64xlarge. Each profile maps to QEMU smp, pinning, NUMA distance, cgroups v2 cpu.max, and hybrid scheduler hints for Zen5 and Lion Cove.
